question: 按季度统计2024年的订单数量，每个季度各有多少笔订单？
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN substr(order_date, 6, 2) IN ('01','02','03') THEN 'Q1' WHEN substr(order_date, 6, 2) IN ('04','05','06') THEN 'Q2' WHEN substr(order_date, 6, 2) IN ('07','08','09') THEN 'Q3' ELSE 'Q4' END AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date <= '2024-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
